Plan: [QUO-60](nimbalyst://QUO-60). Milestone: M4. Dependencies: [QUO-62](nimbalyst://QUO-62) and [QUO-64](nimbalyst://QUO-64) for in-space acceptance.


**Outcome and scope**

Integrate the controller vocabulary/mapping work under the consolidated controllers owner and implement Godot desktop/OpenXR adapters. Keep private preferences with the user and live hardware observations transient. Preserve the current authorized transient movement lane and U→A durable operations. Use server-authoritative physics where applicable; client interpolation does not need a second physics simulation.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Desktop navigation, picking and GUI controls operate the same offered model; controller preference changes use governed operations and survive reconnect.
- [ ] Focus loss, source removal, disconnect, stale samples and pointer capture cancel the correct inputs without delayed clicks or competing travel writes.
- [ ] XR start/stop releases subscriptions, captures and rendering resources; retain known shutdown failures until a reproduction demonstrates their resolution.
- [ ] Record automated/simulated and physical Vive results separately. Quest hardware qualification is explicitly unrun; an Android export is not headset acceptance.

**Existing work:** integrate [QUO-59](nimbalyst://QUO-59) rather than recreating its domain model. [QUO-27](nimbalyst://QUO-27) retains native XR qualification/shutdown obligations; validate its applicable cases on the replacement, never restore the rejected Rust bridge to satisfy its old setup. Browser startup work [QUO-58](nimbalyst://QUO-58) remains separate.

**Review refinements — additional acceptance**

- [ ] Integrate the current accepted QUO-59 design/implementation, not its superseded review questions; preserve still-valid regressions while moving vocabulary out of mandatory lobby ownership.
- [ ] Any physical acceptance gap remains explicit and unchecked; do not claim headset success from simulation or an export.

**Execution**

[Coordinator](nimbalyst://session/ed9cd520-b2a4-4607-a8f5-ff99d08f3e46) supplies the next applicable checkpoint with current prerequisite evidence. The initial branch base below is provenance, not an instruction to reset later work.
